headline: BFF VIP Sale Pass for ₹9 (Insiders)
description: Myntra Insiders can buy the Big Fashion Festival VIP Sale Pass for 9 rupees instead of 19 rupees with this code. The pass gives early access to the BFF sale from 7 Oct 2026 (main sale from 8 Oct), daily VIP deals and extra discounts on select brands.
how_to_redeem:
1. Open the Myntra app as an Insider member.
2. Go to the BFF VIP ticket / sale pass page.
3. Apply code VIPACCESSINS and buy the pass.
terms: Myntra Insiders only; applies to the VIP Sale Pass purchase only; pass benefits as listed by Myntra.
verified_note: Listed on DesiDime BFF 2026 roundup (2 Oct 2026) — not yet checked by us

headline: Extra 10% Off select Nike (prepaid)
description: Extra 10% off on select eligible Nike products on Myntra when paying online (prepaid), during BFF early-bird / sale.
how_to_redeem:
1. Add eligible Nike products to your Myntra bag.
2. Apply code PREPAIDNIKE10 at checkout.
3. Pay online (prepaid) — not valid on cash on delivery.
terms: Select Nike SKUs only; prepaid orders only.
verified_note: Listed on DesiDime BFF 2026 roundup (2 Oct 2026) — not yet checked by us

headline: Up to 50% off dining — Great Indian Restaurant Festival (no code)
description: Swiggy Dineout's festival (branded Great Indian Ravi Festival): up to 50% off at 57,000+ restaurants in 84+ cities, plus an extra 10% instant discount on HDFC Bank cards and 10% DineCash back. Runs till 24 Oct 2026.
how_to_redeem:
1. Open Swiggy and go to Dineout.
2. Pick a participating restaurant and book a table or pay the bill via Dineout.
3. Discount applies automatically; pay with an HDFC Bank card for the extra 10%.
terms: Participating restaurants only; discount % varies by restaurant; HDFC and DineCash extras have their own caps.

headline: Save up to ₹300 on bus tickets
description: Save up to 300 rupees on bus ticket bookings on redBus.
how_to_redeem:
1. Search and select your bus on redBus.
2. Apply code BUS300 on the payment page.
3. Complete the booking.
terms: Discount varies by fare/route; redBus T&Cs apply.
